identity.title: [Backlog][C-SDLC v2] Remove retired csdlc-migrate from installer and coexistence authority

values.summary: Inventory current authority, make the smallest proven correction or evidence-only disposition, then prove install, resolve, provenance, retired-surface guard, and one installed lifecycle canary.

steps.action: Classify every current csdlc-migrate reference and determine whether active drift remains.
Delete only proven active stale expectations and add or tighten one focused negative guard, or record an already-resolved no-code disposition.
Build and install the declared current v2 set and verify selector plus exact provenance.
Run the installed claim-free create, validate, and bind canary and retain results.

invariants: No retired binary or compatibility shim
risks: Mistaking historical text for active authority
Passing with a stale installed generation
Adding code when the issue is already resolved
stop_conditions: Any need to restore or wrap csdlc-migrate
Installed provenance cannot be tied to exact source
The representative lifecycle canary does not use installed binaries
